Weight is the most common measure of anthropometrics. Un-
fortunately, it is a gross measurement of all body compartments 
and does not distinguish body composition or ﬂ uid shifts. 
Nevertheless, due to its common availability and its relation-
ship to growth, development, and health, it is a vital component 
of nutrition assessment.
